title: Global Esports ousts host favorite EDward Gaming from VALORANT Champions Shanghai
summary: Global Esports (GE) delivered a resounding victory in VALORANT Champions Shanghai, ousting hometown favorites EDward Gaming (EDG) in an elimination battle, 2-0, on Friday.
